close_reason: Fixed via Option 1 from the bead description: .iter().map(...).collect::<Result<Vec<(String, String)>, String>>() short-circuits on the first Err and replaces the loop+flag+break+post-loop-check pattern. The map closure returns Err on either suffix-validation failure or value-shape failure; the post-collect match dispatches Ok(decoded) into the success path and Err(desc) into the not_updated table + continue. No behavior change; all chat-server tests still pass.
